question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **but**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• But is used for introducing an idea that contrasts with or is different from what has just been said.

 -Example: I’d love to come **but **I can’t make it till 8 o’clock.

 
• 'But' is the conjunction used to connect words, clauses or parts of sentences.
 
• 'But' is usually used to link items which are of the same grammatical type (**coordinating conjunction**).
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'But'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 'So' is used to emphasize an adjective or adverb, especially when this produces a particular result.
 
• **'Because'** means for the reason that.
 
• **'Or'** means if not; otherwise.
